title: worker.dispatched
description: Emitted when a task becomes bound to a worker (real dispatch event). v0.9.4: emitted by trg_attempt_dispatched_event_emit_insert and _update on task_attempts INSERT/UPDATE with non-NULL worker_id and active status. Closes Codex v0.9.3 P1-2 finding: the v0.9.3 trigger of the same name was actually a registration event; the new triggers split the conflation. Strategy values: 'capability_match' (initial dispatch from WorkerPool.dispatch) or 'worker_takeover' (UPDATE OF worker_id).

task_id.description: Task that was assigned (TEXT PK in tasks table).

worker_id.description: Worker that received the assignment (TEXT PK in workers table).

attempt_id.description: The active attempt bound to this worker at dispatch time.

strategy.description: How the dispatch was decided. 'capability_match' = WorkerPool.dispatch picked this worker via capability + round-robin. 'worker_takeover' = UPDATE OF task_attempts.worker_id, e.g. after lease expiry handoff.

dispatched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at moment of dispatch.
